verdicts.reason: The repo still has `{edu: 3, stem: true, ageUnder: 30, countries: asiaPilot}` in E-7-1 needs, and I ran the engine to check it: a 25-year-old Indian STEM bachelor with 0 years of experience who answered 'not QS top 500' gets E-7-1 OPEN and tagged as a match, while the same Uzbek reader is blocked. The quoted E-7 general and special requirements have no route limited by nationality or age. The asiaPilot list matches the D-10 points bonus word for word (9 countries, 29 or under, QS-1000 STEM, 20 points, pilot until '27.10). The repo's own 2026 E-7-1 change and abroad document lists have no case for such a route. Caveat: I could not reopen the manual itself because the search budget was used up and WebFetch could not resolve hosts, so this rests on the auditor's verbatim manual quotes plus the in-repo transcription.

verdicts.reason: The legal core holds: 별표 1의3 제8호 has a licence branch ('또는 법무부장관이 정하는 기술자격증'), needs only 3 years' residence in Korea, and names no prior status. E-7-4 and E-7-4R lack the edge, and F-5-10's visa-level needs `[{edu:3,stem:true},{koreanEdu:4}]` would hide a licence holder, so `needs: {}` on the move is the only way to express it. But the claim that E-7-4 points-table licences make holders 'the normal case' is not shown. The points table rewards 기능사/산업기사/기사, and which level the MOJ-listed licence must be is unconfirmed; the repo itself says 'engineer licence'. The route also needs a wage of 1× GNI (about ₩52.4M) against E-7-4's ₩26M floor, so the note should name the MOJ list, full-time work and the wage rather than imply any licence suffices.

verdicts.reason: The claim holds: E-7-3 needs `[{edu:3},{koreanEdu:2},{experience:1}]`, and the engine leaves E-7-3 OPEN for a high-school reader with 1 year of experience. The quoted occupation rules have no route on 1 year of experience alone. But raising it to 5 years is wrong. The finding's own source makes the main E-7-3 trade, 조선용접공, open with a licence plus 2 years and a skills test, and the engine has no licence fact, so `{experience: 5}` would block those welders. The in-repo 2026 document lists also show regional welder and painter pilots (Ulsan and Gyeongnam, until 2026-12-31) that ask for a certificate or skills test and no experience certificate. The right floor is the shortest experience leg in the chapter (2 years), plus the 전문학사 + experience leg for 양식기술자.

verdicts.reason: The level-4 rule comes from the 2025-02-20 MOJ plan and is out of date. 법무부고시 제2026-248호 (amended, in force since 2026-08-03) put the F-2-R requirement back to KIIP 3 or TOPIK 3. Its 제4조제1항 was read in full by an earlier agent: 'KIIP stage 3+ (incl. pre-test placement 4+) or TOPIK 3+'. The repo's transcription of the 2026.9.18 sojourn manual's F-2-R change list agrees: '기본소양 요건 입증서류' = KIIP level-3 completion or pre-test placement at level 4+, or TOPIK 3+. The repo's `lang: {topik: 3, kiip: 3}` and 'KIIP 3 or TOPIK 3' are therefore correct for 2026, and the finding's practitioner blogs reflect the superseded 2025 rule.
